events.name: Bash
events.head: Check walkthrough checkout, review pages and ledger
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthrough* 2>/dev/null && pwd && git status --short | head -5; git log --oneline | head -3; ls scripts/walkthroughs | head -30; for t in kie stripe hubspot zoho wistia twilio dodo google-senders; do printf "%s " $t; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " "http://localhost:8883/wt-review/$t/index.html?v=t283c"; done; echo; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "index %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8883/wt-review/index.html?v=t283c"; tail -8 scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | cut -c1-300; grep -n "T-283" -A12 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tasks/

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run verify on the 8 tools and scan for stale access wording
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && sed -n 1,30p scripts/walkthroughs/verify.py | grep -n "argv\|usage\|Usage" | head; for t in kie stripe hubspot zoho wistia twilio dodo google-senders; do echo "== $t"; python3 scripts/walkthroughs/verify.py $t 2>&1 | tail -2 | cut -c1-200; done; ls app/public/wt-review | head -30; grep -il "waiting for access\|waiting on access\|blocked on account" app/public/wt-review/*/index.html app/public/wt-review/index.html scripts/walkthroughs/journeys/*.md 2>/dev/null | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect the Stripe journey wording
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && git status --short | head; grep -n -i "waiting for access\|waiting on access\|blocked on account" scripts/walkthroughs/journeys/stripe.md | cut -c1-400; grep -n -i "block\|docs\|sign-in\|T-350" scripts/walkthroughs/journeys/stripe.md | cut -c1-260 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check what verify changed and read the stale Stripe line
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && git remote -v | head -1; git branch --show-current; git diff --stat | tail -1; git diff scripts/walkthroughs/recordings/kie/timeline.json | head -12 | cut -c1-200; sed -n 60,64p scripts/walkthroughs/journeys/stripe.md | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Restore timelines, fix the stale line, commit, probe the 8 videos

events.text: Checking the 8 videos still play at 4K, then I'll close out the task note.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Probe size and length of the 8 videos and that the server serves them
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && FP=$(ls /opt/homebrew/bin/ffprobe /usr/local/bin/ffprobe 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -z "$FP" ] && FP=$(find . ~/.cache -name "ffprobe*" -type f -perm +111 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "ffprobe=$FP"; for t in kie stripe hubspot zoho wistia twilio dodo google-senders; do f=app/public/wt-review/$t/$t-4k.mp4; printf "%s " $t; if [ -n "$FP" ]; then "$FP" -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height:format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$f" | tr '\n' ' '; else mdls -name kMDItemPixelWidth -name kMDItemPixelHeight -name kMDItemDurationSeconds "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Probe video dimensions and durations
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && D=scripts/walkthroughs/motion/node_modules/@remotion/compositor-darwin-arm64; for t in kie stripe hubspot zoho wistia twilio dodo google-senders; do printf "%s " $t; DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=$D $D/ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height:format=duration -of csv=p=0 app/public/wt-review/$t/$t-4k.mp4 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-80; echo; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Set T-283 to review and acknowledge the note
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py set T-283 status=review note="Related update on T-215 checked: the decided approach (Kie.ai docs only, Stripe sign-up plus its docs route with no account, HubSpot, Zoho and Wistia from public docs, Twilio, Dodo and Google live sign-ins split to T-350) is already what the 8 videos show, so no video was rebuilt. One leftover line in the Stripe journey file still said 'Waiting on access'; it now states the docs route (commit 1a50789 on branch tantra-walkthroughs, not pushed). Rechecked today: verify.py passes on all 8, each mp4 is 3840 x 2160 and 59 to 119 se
